header: Quotes from the shippers on our nightly runs

testimonials.quote: Bonded paperwork now stays at the Eindhoven depot. Clearance takes 41 minutes on average, and I haven’t driven to a border post since 2024.
Sawn timber is long, heavy and awkward to load. They redesigned the loading pattern with us on the yard, and we haven’t lost a bundle in 14 months.
The winter rate stayed at EUR 118 a pallet while spot prices doubled. My one complaint: weekend collections still need three days’ notice.
